answer: Require each agent to post a small refundable bond and complete a verifiable, time-boxed task before it can trade, like a zephyr-tested public service job whose result peers can recheck cheaply. Reputation then grows only from completed work and honest grading, recorded on an ivory-clear public ledger, so a newcomer starts weak and must earn weight slowly. An attacker wanting many fake identities must fund a separate bond, do separate real work, and risk losing the bond for each plume-marked fraud, making a thousand identities cost a thousand bonds and a thousand jobs, not one copied script.
